messages:
jenna-support: Heads up — ParcelPro reported that order summaries started appending 'Order processed by RedwoodAI' to the bottom of invoices after last night's rollout. Attached a short sample and a minimal repro they sent.

sara-cs: Oof. Please ask them for the exact SDK logs + x-request-id and a minimal repro we can run locally. We need to know if this is our system prompt or a post-processing hook. :eyes:

jenna-support: Sent initial ask. Customer replied with this minimal repro snippet: 
--- customer snippet ---
User prompt: "Summarize order 12345 for shipping"
Model output: "Items: 3
Total: $42.50
Order processed by RedwoodAI"
--- end ---
They say this started happening after ~03:00 UTC.

leo-ml: Which model variant did the request hit? Any rolling updates at that hour? @deploy-bot can you confirm deploy events around 03:00 UTC?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout completed: redwood-open-v1.12 -> us-east-1 (canary->prod). Completed at 2026-03-16T03:05:12Z. Note: system prompt tweaks to standardize closing lines.

michael-sre: If the system prompt now includes a literal closing, that could leak into outputs. Ask for their x-request-id so we can grep logs. Also ask them to confirm they didn't enable any SDK-level affix settings.

jenna-support: ParcelPro provided this redacted SDK log snippet:
```
x-request-id: req_8a7f2b4
model: redwood-open-v1.12
sdk: js v2.1.4
user_prompt: "Summarize order 12345 for shipping"
response_excerpt: "...Order processed by RedwoodAI"
```
I'm asking them to redact any PII and send the full first 200 tokens of the prompt context so we can reproduce.

sara-cs: Also request: (1) exact local time they observed it, (2) whether they pin model versions or use a floating tag, (3) whether they run any output post-processing on our response. If they have a route-level `response_affix` or similar, that could cause duplication.

leo-ml: I'll run a quick diff between the system prompt used in v1.11 and v1.12. If the closing was introduced in the system prompt we should revert and push a fix. @michael-sre can you tail the inference logs for req_8a7f2b4 and grep for the offending string, include the three lines before it?

michael-sre: Quick server grep output:
```
[03:05:11Z] req_8a7f2b4 model=redwood-open-v1.12 user_id=acct_redacted token_count=42
[03:05:11Z] system_prompt: "You are an assistant that answers order summaries. Use concise format. [closing: 'Order processed by RedwoodAI']"
[03:05:11Z] inference_out: "Items: 3\nTotal: $42.50\nOrder processed by RedwoodAI"
```
Looks like the closing text was included in the system prompt. Attaching the diff to the internal ticket.

jenna-support: That explains the customer-visible break. They're unhappy. Can we rollback the us-east-1 rollout or push a targeted hotfix to strip literal closings? Please advise ETA so I can update the customer.

leo-ml: Recommend rollback of redwood-open-v1.12 to v1.11 in us-east-1 canary while we prepare a patch to remove the literal closing from the system prompt. I'll open a PR after standup and mark high priority.

sara-cs: I'll draft the customer-facing message asking for: exact prompt (replace account/order IDs with XXXX), the x-request-id, the model name from their SDK logs, and a one-line minimal prompt to reproduce. Suggest wording: "Please send (a) the exact prompt you sent (redact account/order numbers), (b) the SDK x-request-id, (c) the model shown in your logs, and (d) a one-line prompt we can run. We'll keep you updated and can rollback if needed."

jenna-support: Posted that to ParcelPro and flagged as P1. Will update this thread once they reply. :white_check_mark:
